FirstPeriodIrregular.1:
Ukuya kwami esikhathini kokuqala
akulandeli uhlelo: ingabe kujwayelekile?
FirstPeriodIrregular.6: Yebo, kujwayelekile impela. Nazi izizathu zokuthi kungani umjikelezo uthatha isikhathi ukuze uzinze, nokuthi kufanele kukhulunywe nini ngakho.
FirstPeriodIrregular.11: Ama-hormone alawula umjikelezo athatha isikhathi ukuze azifumanele ukulingana. Ngakho kuyajwayeleka ukuthi imijikelezo ibe mifushane, mide, noma ingalingani eminyakeni embalwa yokuqala.
FirstPeriodIrregular.12: Umjikelezo ungathatha unyaka owodwa kuya kwemibili, kwesinye isikhathi kancane ngaphezulu, ukuze uvele uhleleke kangcono. Leli xesha lokuzivumelanisa lihluka kakhulu phakathi komuntu nomuntu, kungabi yinkinga.
FirstPeriodIrregular.14: Umjikelezo ongahleleki ekuqaleni awuthathwa njengokubambezeleka: umzimba wakho nje uthatha isikhathi osidingayo.
FirstPeriodIrregular.15: Ezimweni eziningi kakhulu, akukho okufanele ukukhathazele. Nokho, kungaba kuhle ukubona udokotela uma ungayi esikhathini izinyanga ezimbalwa ngemva kokuthi uqale ukuya, noma uma une-shwa eliqhubekayo.
FirstPeriodIrregular.17: Ungayi esikhathini izinyanga ezimbalwa, unobuhlungu obukhulu kakhulu, noma ukopha kakhulu kakhulu.
FirstPeriodIrregular.19: Umjikelezo ohlelekile noma ongahlelekile: umehluko uyini?
FirstPeriodIrregular.21: Ukuya kwakho esikhathini kokuqala: okufanele ukulindele
FirstPeriodIrregular.23: Imibuzo evame ukubuzwa ngokuya kwakho esikhathini kokuqala
FirstPeriodIrregular.25: Ukuya kwami esikhathini kokuqala akulandeli uhlelo: ingabe kujwayelekile? — AWA

FirstPeriodProtection.1:
Yiluphi uvikelo okufanele ngilukhethe
esikhathini sami sokuqala?
FirstPeriodProtection.6: Zikhona izindlela eziningana zokuzivikela ngesikhathi sokuya esikhathini. Akukho ngcono kunenye — induduzo yakho iyiyona eholela ekukhetheni.
FirstPeriodProtection.11: Ekuyeni kwakho esikhathini kokuqala, iphedi imvamisa iyona ndlela elula yokusebenzisa, njengoba ihamba ngqo phakathi kwezingubo zangaphansi. Izingubo zangaphansi zesikhathi nama-tampon kuyizinketho ezinye ongazizama kamuva, noma nini lapho uzizwa uthanda.
FirstPeriodProtection.13: Alula ukusebenzisa, afakwa phakathi kwezingubo zangaphansi futhi ashintshwa njalo.
FirstPeriodProtection.15: Izingubo zangaphansi ezimunca futhi ezigezwayo ezikhululekile ukuzigqokela nsuku zonke.
FirstPeriodProtection.17: Afakwa ngaphakathi emzimbeni; ukuthi uwasebenzisa yini nokuthi nini kuncike kuwe, ngejubane lakho.
FirstPeriodProtection.18: Akukho uvikelo olulungile noma olungalungile: ngamunye ulingana nemizimba, izijwayezi nezinga lokukhululeka okuhlukene. Ama-tampon, isibonelo, afakwa ngaphakathi emzimbeni futhi adinga ukuwazi kancane ngaphezulu — akukho okusho ukuthi kufanele uwasebenzise kusukela esikhathini sakho sokuqala.
FirstPeriodProtection.20: Ukuzama izinhlobo ezahlukene zovikelo ngokuhamba kwesikhathi kukusiza ukuthola olulingana nawe kangcono, ngaphandle kwengcindezi.
FirstPeriodProtection.21: Ngokwesilinganiso, uvikelo kufanele lushintshwe njalo ngamahora angu-4 kuya ku-6, kaningi ezinsukwini zokuhamba kakhulu. Ukulushintsha njalo kukusiza uzizwe ukhululekile futhi ugcine inhlanzeko enhle yezindawo zangasese.
FirstPeriodProtection.25: Ungakuphatha kanjani ukuya kwakho esikhathini kokuqala usuku nosuku?
FirstPeriodProtection.27: Ukuya kwakho esikhathini kokuqala: okufanele ukulindele
FirstPeriodProtection.29: Yiluphi uvikelo okufanele ngilukhethe esikhathini sami sokuqala? — AWA

FirstPeriodSigns.1:
Izimpawu zokuqala
zokuya kwakho esikhathini kokuqala
FirstPeriodSigns.6: Umzimba wakho kaningi ukunika izimpawu ngaphambi kokuthi ufike isikhathi sakho sokuqala. Ukuzibona kungakusiza ungamangali kakhulu.
FirstPeriodSigns.11: Ezinyangeni ngaphambi kokuya kwakho esikhathini kokuqala, umzimba wakho ushintsha kancane: isimo sawo siyashintsha, izinwele zomzimba ziqala ukuvela ezindaweni ezintsha, nokubila nakho kuyashintsha. Lezi yimiphumela evamile yokuthomba, elungiselela umzimba wakho kancane kancane.
FirstPeriodSigns.13: Lolu shintsho aluzenzeki zonke ngesikhathi esisodwa, noma ngejubane elilodwa, kubo bonke — lokho kujwayelekile impela.
FirstPeriodSigns.15: Umzimba wakho ushintsha kancane kancane: isimo sawo, izinwele zomzimba nokubila kungashintsha konke.
FirstPeriodSigns.17: Amanzi alula, abumhlophe ayavela kaningi izinyanga ezimbalwa ngaphambi kokuya kwakho esikhathini kokuqala.
FirstPeriodSigns.19: Ungezwa ukuqina okuncane noma ukuhlinzeka esiswini sakho esingezansi.
FirstPeriodSigns.21: Kuvamile ukuzizwa uzwela kakhulu noma ucasuka kunokujwayelekile.
FirstPeriodSigns.24: Lezi zimpawu zivame ukusho ukuthi isikhathi sakho sokuqala sizofika ezinyangeni ezilandelayo, nakuba kungenakwenzeka ukubikezela usuku oluqondile. Ukugcina uvikelo eduze kuba yisijwayezo esihle ngalesi sikhathi.
FirstPeriodSigns.26: Lezi zimpawu ziyizinkomba ezijwayelekile, hhayi isibikezelo esiqondile. Umzimba ngamunye ulandela ijubane lawo.
FirstPeriodSigns.28: Ukuya kwakho esikhathini kokuqala: okufanele ukulindele
FirstPeriodSigns.30: Ngazi kanjani ukuthi isikhathi sami sokuqala siyeza?
FirstPeriodSigns.34: Izimpawu zokuqala ngaphambi kokuya kwakho esikhathini kokuqala — AWA

FlowColorsTextures.1:
Ukuhamba kwegazi lesikhathi: ukuqonda
emibala nezimo
FlowColorsTextures.6: Umbala nesimo segazi lakho lesikhathi kuyasho okuningi ngempilo yakho yama-hormone. Funda ukukufunda ukuze uqonde umjikelezo wakho kangcono.
FlowColorsTextures.14: Igazi eliqala ukuhamba, igazi elisha. Livamile ekuqaleni kwesikhathi sakho.
FlowColorsTextures.18: Igazi eliphendukile ngenxa yomoya, kaningi ekupheleni kwesikhathi sakho.
FlowColorsTextures.20: Kungabonisa ukuhamba okuncane noma ushintsho lwama-hormone.
FlowColorsTextures.32: Izicubu noma izingcezu zesicubu esikhumbeni sangaphakathi.
FlowColorsTextures.34: Umjikelezo ojwayelekile. Umzimba wakho uyakhipha ungqimba lwesibeletho.
FlowColorsTextures.38: Kungenzeka ekuqaleni/ekupheleni kwesikhathi sakho noma uma ama-hormone engalingani.
FlowColorsTextures.40: Kwazise uma kuhambisana nephunga elinamandla, ukuhlukumeza noma ubuhlungu.
FlowColorsTextures.42: Ukopha kakhulu kakhulu (ukushintsha uvikelo njalo emahoreni angu-1–2)
FlowColorsTextures.47: Qaphela noma yikuphi ukushintsha inyanga ngayinye.
FlowColorsTextures.49: Ngokuya ngokuhamba kwegazi lakho nendlela ozizwa ngayo.
FlowColorsTextures.54: Ukuhamba kwegazi lesikhathi: ukuqonda imibala nezimo — AWA

FlowMenstrual.1:
Ukunakekela inhlanzeko yakho yezindawo zangasese
ngesikhathi sokuya esikhathini
FlowMenstrual.6: Ukunakekela inhlanzeko yezindawo zakho zangasese kusho ukuhlonipha umzimba wakho nokulingana kwawo kwemvelo.
FlowMenstrual.13: Ngesikhathi sokuya esikhathini, umzimba wakho uyashintsha futhi uzwela kakhulu. Ukuba nezijwayezi ezifanele kusiza ukuvimbela ukuhlukumeza nezifo ezithathelwanayo, futhi kukusiza ukuthi uzizwe ukhululekile usuku nosuku.
FlowMenstrual.14: Geza kahle: ukukhukhula nje ngamanzi acwebile, kusukela phambili uye emuva, kwanele ukuvikela izinto zakho zemvelo.
FlowMenstrual.15: Shintsha uvikelo lwakho njalo: ngamahora angu-4 kuya ku-6 ukuzeugweme umswakama namaphunga angemnandi.
FlowMenstrual.16: Khetha ukotini: izingubo zangaphansi zikakotini zivumela isikhumba sakho ukuthi siphefumule futhi zehlisa ingozi yokuhlukumeza.
FlowMenstrual.18: Ukuhlanza ngaphakathi ngamanzi, okuphazamisa izinto zakho zemvelo
FlowMenstrual.19: Ukushiya iphedi noma i-tampon enomswakama isikhathi eside kakhulu
FlowMenstrual.21: Iphunga noma ukuphuma kwamanzi okungajwayelekile okuhlukile kokujwayelekile kuwe
FlowMenstrual.24: Umzimba wakho usunendlela yawo yemvelo yokulingana. Ukugeza kahle kuvame ukwanela.
FlowMenstrual.38: Ukunakekela inhlanzeko yakho yezindawo zangasese ngesikhathi sokuya esikhathini · AWA

HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.1: Ukubuka konke ngezindlela zokuvimbela ukukhulelwa ezisebenzisa ama-hormone
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.6: Ipilisi, iphetshi, indandatho, i-implant, i-IUD ye-hormone: yini ezihlukanisayo nokuthi ungacabanga kanjani ngendlela elingana kangcono nempilo yakho yansuku zonke.
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.12: Izindlela ze-hormone zisebenzisa ama-hormone ukuvimbela ukukhulelwa. Kuye ngendlela, zingavimbela kakhulu i-ovulation, zenze isikhumba esiphuma esibelethweni sibe sinzima, futhi zishintshe indawo yesibeletho.
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.16: Ezinye izindlela zivimbela noma zinciphisa ukukhululwa kweqanda.
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.18: Lesi sikhumba singaba sinzima, okwenza kube nzima kakhulu ukuthi isidoda sidlule.
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.20: Ukuhlangana kwalezi zindlela kusiza ukunciphisa ingozi yokukhulelwa.
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.21: Akuzona zonke izindlela ezidinga izinga elifanayo lokuzibandakanya. Umehluko oyinhloko ukuthi kufanele ucabange kangaki ngokuvimbela kwakho ukukhulelwa.
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.23: Kusukela esenzweni sansuku zonke kuya kuvikelo lwesikhathi eside
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.30: Kulungile uma ufuna ukuzilawula ngokwakho izindlela zakho zokuvimbela ukukhulelwa
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.34: Ilula uma ungathandi umkhuba wansuku zonke
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.38: Inketho engabonakali kakhulu enezenzo ezimbalwa zansuku zonke
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.42: Ilungele uma ufuna ukuvimbela ukukhulelwa isikhathi eside
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.46: Isixazululo sesikhathi eside esidinga ukunakekelwa okuncane kakhulu
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.48: Uma indlela idinga izenzo ezimbalwa zansuku zonke, kuncane kaningi okudingeka ukucabange ngayo. Lokhu kungaba ukucabanga okufanele uma wazi ukuthi ungaba nokukhohlwa umthamo noma ukushintsha.
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.49: Alikho indlela ephelele kubo bonke. Ukukhetha okungcono kuncike empilweni yakho yansuku zonke, ezintandweni zakho, ekubekezeleni kwakho, nasezinhlelweni zakho.
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.51: Ezinye izindlela zidinga isenzo sansuku zonke, kanti ezinye zisebenza amaviki amaningana noma iminyaka.
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.53: Indlela efakazela ngayo ingahluka phakathi komuntu nomuntu. Ukukhuluma nochwepheshe wezempilo kungakusiza ukuthola okulingana nawe.
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.55: Uma ulangazelela ukukhulelwa maduze noma kamuva, isikhathi sendlela nokuthi ingabuyiselwa yini kungaholela ukukhetha kwakho.
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.57: Ukuhlakanipha, ukulula, ukungabi nomkhuba wansuku zonke, noma uvikelo olumisayo: okubalulekile kuwe kunendawo kulesi sinqumo.
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.59: “Ngingathanda ukucabanga ngokuvimbela kwami ukukhulelwa nsuku zonke, njalo ngeviki, noma kuphela izikhathi ezimbalwa ngonyaka?”
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.61: Ipilisi noma indlela edinga ukunakwa njalo
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.63: Iphetshi noma indandatho, kuye ngesigqi osikhethayo
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.65: I-implant noma i-IUD ye-hormone yesikhathi eside
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.67: Ukukhetha indlela yokuvimbela ukukhulelwa nge-hormone kufanele kucabangele isimo sakho siqu nesempilo. Uchwepheshe wezempilo angakusiza uqhathanise izinzuzo, izingozi, izizathu zokungasebenzisi, nemiphumela engase ibe khona.
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.70: Izindlela ze-hormone zisebenzisa ukuhlangana okuhlukile kwama-hormone nezinhlelo ezahlukene zokusetshenziswa.
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.71: Ipilisi, iphetshi nendandatho kudinga ukuzibandakanya okuqhubekayo, kanti i-implant ne-IUD ye-hormone izindlela zesikhathi eside.
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.72: Ukukhetha kufanele kulingane nempilo yakho yansuku zonke, izintandokazi zakho, ukubekezela kwakho nezinhlelo zakho.
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.73: Alikho indlela “engcono kakhulu” kubo bonke — kudingeka ikakhulukazi ihambisane nezidingo zakho nesimo sakho.
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.75: Ukuthatha isikhathi ukuqhathanisa izindlela nochwepheshe wezempilo kukusiza ukhethe indlela yokuvimbela ukukhulelwa ongayisebenzisa ngokuthula nangokuzinzile.
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.76: Ukubuka konke ngezindlela zokuvimbela ukukhulelwa ezisebenzisa ama-hormone — AWA

HotFlashes.6: Kungani kwenzeka, ungazikhomba kanjani izimbangela zakho, nokuthi yiziphi izixazululo ezingasiza uma sekuyinkathazo.
HotFlashes.14: Ukushisa okuphumayo kuvamile kakhulu ngesikhathi sokudlulela ekupheleni kokuya esikhathini. Kuhlobene ngokwengxenye noshintsho lwama-hormone olubhekene nendlela ubuchopho elawula ngayo izinga lokushisa lomzimba.
HotFlashes.15: Ushintsho oluncane ekushiseni komzimba lungazwakala njengokushisa okuzumayo. Umzimba uphendula ngokunweba imithambo yegazi esikhumbeni, okungabangela umuzwa wokushisa, ukubomvu, futhi kwesinye isikhathi ukubila okukhulu.
HotFlashes.17: Abanye besifazane bahlangabezana nezikhathi ezimbalwa ngeviki, kanti abanye bangaba nezimbalwa ngosuku. Ubukhulu nobude nakho kungahluka.
HotFlashes.18: Uma kwenzeka ngesikhathi ulele, ukushisa kungabangela ukubila ebusuku. Kungaholela ekuvukeni kaningi futhi kwenze ukulala kungabi muhle.
HotFlashes.19: Ukushoda kokulala kungandisa ukukhathala, ubunzima bokugxila nokucasuka emini. Ngakho kungasiza ukucabangela ikhwalithi yokulala uma ulinganisa umthelela wezimpawu zakho.
HotFlashes.21: Izingubo zokulala eziphefumulayo, izimbozo ezilula, negumbi lokulala elipholile ngokwanele kungasiza ukunciphisa ukungakhululeki ebusuku.
HotFlashes.22: Ezinye izinto zingabangela noma zandise ukushisa. Azibangeli izimpawu kubo bonke, kodwa ukuzikhomba kungakusiza uqonde kangcono indlela yakho siqu.
HotFlashes.26: Igumbi eliqhumayo ngokweqile noma izingubo ezisinda kakhulu
HotFlashes.28: Amasonto ambalwa, qaphela uma ukushisa kwakho kwenzeka, ukuthi kukhulu kangakanani, nokuthi kwenzekani ngaphambi kwalokho. Lokhu kungakusiza ukhombe izimbangela zakho siqu.
HotFlashes.30: Gcina indawo yakho ipholile futhi inomoya omuhle
HotFlashes.33: Lezi zindlela azizukwenza ukushisa kunyamalale ngempela, kodwa zingenza izikhathi zibe lula ukuzilawula futhi zehlise ukungakhululeki lapho zenzeka.
HotFlashes.34: Ukushisa kuvamile ngesikhathi sokudlulela ekupheleni kokuya esikhathini nasemva kokuya esikhathini. Nokho, akudingeki ukuthi ukubekezelele nje uma sekunzima ukuphila nakho. Udokotela noma umbelethisi angahlola izimpawu zakho futhi akhulume nawe ngezinketho ezahlukene.
HotFlashes.36: Ukubonana kungaba usizo ikakhulukazi uma izimpawu zinomthelela omkhulu empilweni yakho yansuku zonke noma uma ufuna ukwazi ukuthi yiziphi izinketho ezikhona.
HotFlashes.38: Ukushisa okuvamile noma ukubila ebusuku okubangela ukuvuka kaningi, ukukhathala okukhulu, noma ubunzima bokusebenza ngokujwayelekile emini.
HotFlashes.39: Uma impilo yansuku zonke iba nzima
HotFlashes.40: Uma ukushisa kuphazamisa umsebenzi wakho, imisebenzi, uhambo, ubudlelwano nabanye, noma nje induduzo yakho yansuku zonke.
HotFlashes.42: Ukwanda okusobala kwemvamisa noma ubukhulu bezimpawu kufanele kukhulunywe ngakho ukuze kutholwe izixazululo ezifanele kakhulu.
HotFlashes.44: Izinketho ezinama-hormone nezingenawo zingase zinikezwe kuye ngesimo sakho. Uchwepheshe angakusiza ukulinganisa izinzuzo zazo, izingozi, nanoma yiziphi izizathu zokungasebenzisi.
HotFlashes.45: Ungabeki konke emaphutheni okuphela kokuya esikhathini
HotFlashes.46: Ukushisa kungaba nezimbangela ezahlukene. Ezinye izimpawu zingahlobana nomuthi, esinye isimo sezempilo, noma ushintsho olukhulu empilweni yakho. Uma okuthile kuzwakala kungajwayelekile, kusha, noma kunamandla ngokukhethekile, kungcono ukukhuluma nochwepheshe kunokucabanga ngokuzenzakalelayo ukuthi kuyindlela yokuphela kokuya esikhathini.
HotFlashes.48: Ubuhlungu esifubeni, ukuphelelwa umoya okuzumayo, ukuzizwa ufuna ukuquleka, ubuthakathaka obuzumayo, noma ukuvuvukala okungajwayelekile okunobuhlungu ekhoneni elilodwa kudinga ukunakekelwa ngokwezokwelapha masinyane.
HotFlashes.51: Ukuphelelwa umoya okuzumayo noma ubunzima obukhulu bokuphefumula
HotFlashes.53: Ubuthakathaka obuzumayo, noma ubunzima bokukhuluma noma bokubona
HotFlashes.56: Uma ukushisa kuyinkathazo ngokwanele ukudinga ukulawulwa, izindlela eziningana zingacatshangelwa. Kuye ngesimo sakho, uchwepheshe angakhuluma ngezindlela zokuphila, izindlela zokwelapha ezingenawo ama-hormone, noma, lapho kufanele, ukwelashwa ngama-hormone.
HotFlashes.58: Iminyaka, izimpawu, umlando wezokwelapha, ukwelashwa kwamanje, nezintandokazi zakho zonke kungathinta izinketho eziphakanyiswayo.
HotFlashes.60: Ukufika unolwazi oluthile kungenza ukubonana kube usizo olukhulu. Ungabhala, amasonto noma izinsuku ezimbalwa, ukuthi zenzeka kangaki izikhathi, zingakanani, nomthelela wazo ekulaleni kwakho noma emisebenzini yakho.
HotFlashes.64: Kuvame ukwenzeka emini, ebusuku, noma kokubili?
HotFlashes.67: Ingabe okwamanje uthatha umuthi noma indlela yokuvimbela ukukhulelwa enama-hormone?
HotFlashes.68: Akudingeki ulinde ukuthi izimpawu zibe nzima kakhulu ngaphambi kokukhuluma ngazo. Ukubonana kungakusiza nje ukuqonda ukuthi kwenzekani nokufunda ngezixazululo ezikhona.
HotFlashes.70: Ukushisa kuvamile ngesikhathi sokudlulela ekupheleni kokuya esikhathini.
HotFlashes.71: Ukukhomba izimbangela zakho kungakusiza ulawule izikhathi kangcono.
HotFlashes.72: Izijwayezi ezilula zingehlisa ukungakhululeki kwansuku zonke.
HotFlashes.73: Uma izimpawuziphazamisa ukulala kwakho noma impilo yakho yansuku zonke, khuluma nochwepheshe.
HotFlashes.74: Izindlela eziningana zokulawula zingakhulunywa ngazo kuye ngesimo sakho.
HotFlashes.75: Ukushisa kuvamile, kodwa akufanele kuphathwe kancane uma kuthinta ukulala kwakho, umsebenzi, noma inhlala-kahle. Ukunaka izimpawu zakho nokukhuluma nochwepheshe kungakusiza uqonde kangcono imbangela futhi uhlole izixazululo ezifanele.
HotFlashes.76: Lesi sihloko sinikeza ulwazi kuphela futhi asithathi indawo yeseluleko sezokwelapha esikhethekile kuwe.

HydrationCycle.1:
Ukuhlala unamanzi emzimbeni
ngomjikelezo wakho wonke
HydrationCycle.6: Kuyamangaza kodwa kuyiqiniso: ukuhlala unamanzi emzimbeni kuhle kusiza umzimba wakho ugcine amanzi amancane ngomjikelezo wakho wonke.
HydrationCycle.15: Kuyamangaza kodwa kuyiqiniso: ukuhlala unamanzi emzimbeni kuhle kusiza umzimba ugcine amanzi amancane futhi kwehlise ukuvuvukala kwesisu, ikakhulukazi ekupheleni komjikelezo.
HydrationCycle.17: Uma umzimba ushoda amanzi, uvame ukuwagcina amaningi njengesixwayiso. Ukuphuza anele, ngokuphambene, kuwutshela ukuthi ungawakhulula kalula.
HydrationCycle.18: Izidingo zakho zamanzi zihlala zizinzile ngokujwayelekile, ngokuhluka okuncane kuye ngesigaba:
HydrationCycle.20: Amanzi amaningi kancane asiza ukunxephezela amanzi alahlekayo futhi anciphise ukuvuvukala kwesisu.
HydrationCycle.22: Izidingo zihlala zizinzile; ukwenyuka kancane kokushisa komzimba kungandisa ukoma.
HydrationCycle.24: Ukuba namanzi anele emzimbeni kusiza ukunciphisa umuzwa wokuvuvukala ovame ukuzwakala ngalesi sikhathi.
HydrationCycle.25: Hlosa cishe amalitha angu-1.5 kuya ku-2 ngosuku, amaningi kancane ngesikhathi sokuya esikhathini ukuze unxephezele amanzi alahlekayo.
HydrationCycle.27: Cishe amalitha angu-1.5 kuya ku-2 ngosuku, amaningi kancane ngesikhathi sokuya esikhathini.
HydrationCycle.29: Ijinja noma i-chamomile kunikeza amanzi emzimbeni ngobumnene ngesikhathi sezinkathazo.
HydrationCycle.31: Ukunciphisa iziphuzo ezinoshukela omningi noma ikhafini kungasiza ekupheleni komjikelezo.
HydrationCycle.37: Izijwayezi ezimbalwa ezilula zivame ukwanela ukuhlala unamanzi emzimbeni ngaphandle kokucabanga:
HydrationCycle.38: Hlala nebhodlela lamanzi eduze kwakho usuku lonke
HydrationCycle.39: Hlanganisa ingilazi yamanzi nesijwayezo osinaso kakade (ukuvuka, ukudla ngakunye)
HydrationCycle.40: Engeza itiye lamakhambi uma amanzi nje ethoba inkanuko
HydrationCycle.41: Ngesikhathi sokuzivocavoca, khumbula ukuphuza ngaphambi, ngesikhathi nangemva kokuzivocavoca ukunxephezela ukubila.
HydrationCycle.43: "Ukuphuza kakhulu kwenza isisu sami sivuvukale kakhulu."
HydrationCycle.45: Ukuba namanzi anele emzimbeni kusiza umzimba ukuthi ugcine amanzi amancane.
HydrationCycle.47: Amatiye eJinja noma e-chamomile anikeza futhi amanzi emzimbeni athulisayo ngesikhathi sezinkathazo.
HydrationCycle.48: Ukuhlala unamanzi emzimbeni kusiza umzimba ugcine amanzi amancane futhi kwehlise ukuvuvukala kwesisu.
HydrationCycle.49: Hlosa cishe amalitha angu-1.5 kuya ku-2 ngosuku, amaningi kancane ngesikhathi sokuya esikhathini.
HydrationCycle.50: Amatiye eJinja noma e-chamomile angathulisa futhi ngesikhathi sezinkathazo.
HydrationCycle.51: Ukoma okukhulu, okuqhubekayo kufanele kukhulunywe ngakho nochwepheshe wezempilo.
HydrationCycle.52: Okuqukethwe okunikeza ulwazi. Lesi sihloko asithathi indawo yeseluleko sezokwelapha esikhethekile kuwe. Uma une-shwa, funa isiqondiso kochwepheshe wezempilo.

Istihada.6: Ukuhlukanisa ukopha okungahleleki nokuya kwakho esikhathini okujwayelekile, ngezimpawu ezijwayelekile zokukusiza.
Istihada.8: Lokhu okuqukethwe kungokwemfundo kuphela. Imibuzo yenkolo kufanele iqinisekiswe izazi ezifanelekile. I-AWA ayikhiphi ama-fatwa noma izinqumo zenkolo ezikhethekile.
Istihada.17: I-Istihâda ibhekisela ekopheni okwenzeka ngaphandle komjikelezo wesikhathi ojwayelekile, noma okuqhubeka ngaphezu kobude bokuya esikhathini obaziwa isiko lamaSulumane. Ngokungafani nokuya esikhathini (hayd) noma i-nifas (ukopha ngemva kokubeletha), ayinayo isimo senkolo esifanayo: ngokuvamile ithathwa njengokopha kwesimo esihlukile, kwesinye isikhathi okuhlobene nembangela yezokwelapha.
Istihada.19: Lokhu okuqukethwe kuchaza umqondo ngokujwayelekile; akukuvumeli ukuthi unqume ukuthi ukopha okuthile kuhambisana ne-Istihâda esimweni sakho siqu.
Istihada.20: Kungaba nzima ukuhlukanisa i-Istihâda nokuya esikhathini noma umjikelezo ongahleleki, ngoba ukopha kungabukeka kufana kwesinye isikhathi, kuhluke ngobukhulu, noma kuqhubeke ngendlela engajwayelekile. Lobu bunzima buyaziwa ngisho nazizazi ngokwazo, okuchaza ukuthi kungani kukhona izindlela eziningana zokukhomba.
Istihada.22: Kujwayelekile ukungazi masinyane ukuthi ukopha okungajwayelekile kuhambisana nani; lokhu ukungaqiniseki yisimo esivamile, hhayi iphutha lakho.
Istihada.23: Ezinye izinto zingasiza ukuholela ukucabanga kwakho, ngaphandle kokuba yimithetho ejwayelekile, ngoba izimpawu ezicacile zihluka ngokuya ngezikole zomthetho wenkolo.
Istihada.25: Ubude uma uqhathaniswa nomjikelezo wakho ojwayelekile
Istihada.29: Indlela ukopha okuguquka ngayo ngokuhamba kwesikhathi
Istihada.33: Lezi zinto ziyizimpawu ezijwayelekile, hhayi imibandela eqinile: zingachazwa ngendlela ehlukile izazi nezikole zomthetho wenkolo.
Istihada.34: Ukuthatha isikhathi sokubheka ukopha kwakho izinsuku ezimbalwa, ngaphandle kokuphuthuma, kukusiza uqonde isimo sakho siqu kangcono ngaphambi kokufinyelela esiphethweni.
Istihada.36: Qaphela usuku lokuqala futhi, uma kungenzeka, ubude obujwayelekile bemijikelezo yakho
Istihada.37: Bheka ukuthi ukopha kulandela yini ukuma okuseduze nezikhathi zakho zangaphambilini
Istihada.39: Bhala lokhu obukubonile uma uhlela ukubonana nesazi noma uchwepheshe wezempilo
Istihada.40: Esimweni se-Istihâda, ukukhuleka nokuzila ngokuvamile kuhlala kungokwemfanelo, ngokungafani nangesikhathi sokuya esikhathini. Izixwayiso zenhlanzeko (njengoboniso olufanele) ziyanconywa ukuze kuqhubeke ukukhonza, ngokwezindlela ezifundiswa yizikole zomthetho wenkolo ezahlukene.
Istihada.42: Izixwayiso ezicacile (njengokuvuselela i-wudu) zingahluka kuye ngesikole somthetho wenkolo osilandelayo; ukubheka umbono owujwayele ukuwulandela noma ukubuza isazi esifanelekile kukusiza uzisebenzise kahle.
Istihada.43: Ukungabaza okuqhubekayo ngohlobo lokopha kuyisimo esivamile, futhi akufanele kube yimbangela yokukhathazeka ngokweqile.
Istihada.44: Bheka ubude nesigqi esijwayelekile sezikhathi zakho siqu
Istihada.45: Bonana nochwepheshe wezempilo uma ukopha kungajwayelekile noma kuqhubeka isikhathi eside
Istihada.46: Cela isazi esifanelekile umbono waso ngohlangothi lwenkolo
Istihada.47: Khumbula ukuthi impendulo ejwayelekile ayithathi indawo yesiqondiso esilungele isimo sakho
Istihada.49: Lokhu okuqukethwe kuhlala kungokwemfundo nokujwayelekile: akuyona i-fatwa noma isinqumo senkolo somuntu ngamunye. Kunoma yisiphi isimo sakho siqu, ikakhulukazi uma ukungabaza kuqhubeka isikhathi eside, umbono wesazi esifanelekile uhlala uyisethenjwa.
Istihada.51: I-Istihâda ingumqondo ohlukanisa ukopha okungajwayelekile nokuya esikhathini noma i-nifas, onemithelela ethile ekukhulekeni nasekuzileni. Uma une-shwa, ukubheka ngokucophelela nombono wesazi esifanelekile kuhlala kuyizinsiza ezinhle kakhulu.
